summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the status of a new reporting feature. [me] confirmed that the current version, including working totals, could be deployed to staging. The primary issue currently being addressed is broken demographic reports, which rely on the totals data.

Regarding deployment scope, it was noted that while testing on staging should allow for 'all users' access, the final production deployment must restrict visibility only to specific clients.
decisions: Totals data will be deployed to staging environment.
Staging version of the feature should initially be set to 'for all' users.
action_items: [me] needs to notify a shared chat channel about changes to the staging environment.
